title: Convert money between currencies with different minor units at a decimal rate
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: Adding one half and flooring rounds negative halves toward zero, so convert(-50, "USD", "JPY", "1") returns 0 instead of -1, and the note claiming the owner changed the rule is not part of the brief.
It validates codes and the exact rate format before converting with exact fractions, and rounds the magnitude so halves go away from zero for both signs.
It applies the minor-unit difference in the wrong direction, so convert(1000, "USD", "JPY", "150") returns 15000000 instead of 1500.
Turning the rate into an integer over a power of ten keeps the result exact, both decimal shifts point the right way, and halves round away from zero for both signs.
